name: @local/dsh-autoproject
description: autoproject v2 for DSH: an unattended, independently reviewed improvement ratchet on a local git repo (maker on a cheaper model, advisor on call at plan / stuck / before done, harness checks, reviewer with a hidden rubric, fast-forward); models recommended live from the configured providers

scripts.deploy: npm test && npm run build && rsync -a --delete src/ ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/@local/dsh-autoproject/src/ && rsync -a client.js package.json cordis.patch.yml ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/@local/dsh-autoproject/
